hooks.command: out=$("${PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/phi-router" session-start --pid "$PPID" --address "${PHI_ROUTER_ADDRESS:-http://127.0.0.1:47411}") || { code=$?; printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; exit $code; }; printf '%s' "$out"
"${PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/phi-router" codex-prompt || { echo 'phi-router blocked this prompt: it could not read which provider this session sends to.' >&2; exit 2; }

"${PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/phi-router" session-start --pid "$PPID" --address "${PHI_ROUTER_ADDRESS:-http://127.0.0.1:47411}" 1>&2 || echo '{"continue":false,"stopReason":"phi-router: the port does not hold your router, so Codex did not compact."}'
